description: Wait for a run sent with dsh_send to end and return its state and final reply. Prefer the background wait_command from dsh_send if your client wakes you when a background command exits: it costs no turns. It also returns at once when the run stops to ask a person: needs_input answer (reply with dsh_answer) or harness-ui (an approval in the Harness window). Each call waits up to 50 s; if it returns timed_out: true, call dsh_wait again with the same run_id, without a progress note. Parallel runs: all ids in run_ids, never one by one; returns once any ends or asks (ended; the rest in still_running); then wait again with the rest plus your fixes. A run in a session with a Harness goal is followed on until the goal stops, with every round since the run began. With session_id instead of run_id it follows that session's Harness goal (see until) without sending anything; it also returns when Harness needs a person or will not go on by itself. Pass back the cursor each result gives.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous result (nothing is reported twice or missed)

every_minutes.description: With until turn: least minutes between reports

run_ids.description: Several run ids, to wait for whichever ends first

session_id.description: Follow this session's Harness goal instead of waiting for a run (no message is sent)

until.description: Harness goal: goal (default) reports once when it stops; turn (only if the user asked for progress reports) at a round end once every_minutes passed since the last report, with every round since

name: dsh_wait
